title: 有馬記念の後に・道はまだ遠く……

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Super Creek fights hard against some formidable opponents but fails to emerge victorious.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She accepts the results, resolving to stay level-headed and continue improving.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After the race, she reflects on our hardships and how those trials have helped us grow.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She then expresses her hope to race in the Osaka Hai next.
